column1: Debit cards show absolute contraction: their 12-month average volume is 76% below its peak (12 months to Feb 2020). IMPS also shows absolute contraction, past all three thresholds (-28.3% from its peak, 12 months to Jul 2024; beyond 20% since Apr 2026). Credit cards kept growing but lost share to UPI P2M (-7.3 pp). Verdicts (Assignment 2 rule / v2 test): H1 Rejected / Partially supported; H2 Not rejected / Partially supported; H3 Not rejected / Supported.
